blocks.text: Crème de menthe is a sweet, mint-flavored alcoholic beverage. It is available commercially in a colorless version and a green version. Both varieties have similar flavor and are interchangeable in recipes outside of the color aesthetics. It is usually made with Corsican mint or peppermint, which is steeped in grain alcohol for several weeks before it is filtered and sweetened to create the final product. It typically has 25% alcohol by volume.

Crème de menthe is a Canadian short drama film, directed by Jean-Marc E. Roy and Philippe David Gagné, and released in 2017. The film stars Charlotte Aubin as Renée, a young woman who has been left with the responsibility of cleaning out her hoarder father's apartment after his death. Its cast also includes Macha Limonchik and Fred-Éric Salvail.
